author: International Criminal Court (ICC) Pre-Trial Chamber I
locator: Decision ICC-01/18-374 (21 Nov 2024) rejecting pre-warrant Art. 19(2) challenge as premature, and Registry summary of Art. 58(1)(a) arrest warrants for Benjamin Netanyahu, Yoav Gallant, and Mohammed Diab Ibrahim Al-Masri ('Deif')
notes: PROCEDURAL STATUS: Pre-trial arrest warrants issued ex parte under Rome Statute Art. 58(1)(a) on a threshold of 'reasonable grounds to believe' (alleging starvation as a method of warfare and crimes against humanity for Netanyahu/Gallant, and Oct 7 mass atrocities and hostage-taking for Deif). An Art. 58 warrant is NOT a confirmation of charges (Art. 61) or a trial conviction beyond reasonable doubt (Art. 66), where the presumption of innocence strictly applies.
rights: Official judicial record and press registry of the International Criminal Court.
title: Situation in the State of Palestine (ICC-01/18) — Pre-Trial Chamber I Decisions and Article 58 Warrants of Arrest (21 November 2024)
